CREATE TABLE learning_target_stack (
    target_type varchar(32) NOT NULL,
    target_key varchar(255) NOT NULL,
    target_version varchar(64) NOT NULL,
    stack_code varchar(64) NOT NULL,
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    PRIMARY KEY (target_type, target_key, target_version, stack_code),
    FOREIGN KEY (target_type, target_key, target_version)
        REFERENCES learning_target(target_type, target_key, target_version) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    CHECK (stack_code ~ '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{0,63}$')
);

CREATE INDEX learning_target_stack_lookup_idx
    ON learning_target_stack(stack_code, target_type, target_key, target_version);

INSERT INTO learning_target_stack(target_type, target_key, target_version, stack_code) VALUES

    ('capability', 'go.functions-errors', 'v1', 'go'),

    ('capability', 'go.http-service', 'v1', 'go'),
    ('capability', 'go.concurrency-context', 'v1', 'go'),
    ('concept', 'html.structure', 'v1', 'html'),
    ('concept', 'css.grid', 'v1', 'css'),
    ('concept', 'javascript.dom-basics', 'v1', 'javascript'),
    ('capability', 'javascript.dom-events', 'v1', 'javascript'),
    ('capability', 'javascript.event-state', 'v1', 'javascript');
